tax_meat: governments put a tax on meat
tax_meat_and_fund_synthetic_meat_researc: governments tax meat and use some of the revenue to encourage research into synthetic meats
tax_only_highest_emitting_meats: governments tax only the highest-emitting meats, such as beef, rather than all meat
tax_meat_with_import_safeguards: governments tax meat and require imported meat to meet environmental and animal-welfare standards or to pass a high tariff barrier
tax_meat_outside_poor_countries: governments tax meat only outside third-world countries, or with exceptions
tax_meat_with_accompanying_measures: governments tax meat together with targeted accompanying measures against unhealthy underconsumption
regulate_animal_farming_industry: governments regulate the animal farming industry
ration_meat_via_carbon_budgets: governments ration meat through personal carbon budgets (a small amount for everyone, larger amounts at extra cost, very large amounts barred or very expensive)
abolish_meat_subsidies: governments abolish meat subsidies (or at least exempt meat from them)
raise_import_standards: governments maintain import standards for meat at a higher level
tax_damaging_activity: putting a tax on the ecologically damaging activity
change_food_consumption_pattern: people change their food consumption pattern
switch_to_other_protein: people switch to other, cheaper sources of protein
eat_iron_rich_plant_foods: people eat iron-rich plant foods such as beans and lentils
meat_production_and_consumption_harm_env: meat production and consumption are bad for the environment
reduced_meat_consumption: less meat is demanded and consumed (and so less is produced)
environmental_harm_from_meat_reduced: the environmental harm from meat production and consumption is reduced
environmentally_harmful_activity: activities that are bad for the environment
significant_ghg_source: significant sources of greenhouse gas emissions that contribute to climate change
significant_ghg_emissions: significant greenhouse gas emissions are released
soil_devastating_activity: activities whose feed monocultures devastate soil health
feed_monocultures: grain and soy monocultures are grown to feed most animals raised for food
deforestation_for_cropland: forests are cleared for crop production
meat_production_energy_intensive: producing meat consumes far more energy than growing the same nutrients from plant sources
meat_harm_less_than_other_pollution: meat causes significantly less environmental harm than other sources of pollution
meat_can_be_produced_sustainably: meat can be produced in an environmentally friendly manner
regenerative_agriculture_deterred: regenerative agriculture, which produces both meat and environmental benefits, is deterred
beef_impact_far_greater: beef production has a far greater environmental impact (emissions, land, water, reactive nitrogen) than other meats
beef_warrants_higher_tax: a higher tax rate on beef is justified
tax_beef_more_than_wild_game: beef is taxed at a higher rate than wild game such as venison
beef_causes_most_meat_ghg: most greenhouse gas emissions from meat come from beef, while pork, poultry and mutton produce significantly less
only_highest_emitting_meats_taxed: only the highest-emitting meats, such as beef, are taxed
meat_ghg_emissions_reduced: greenhouse gas emissions from meat are reduced
eco_damaging_business_case: the case of ecologically damaging businesses elsewhere (carbon and oil taxes)
higher_meat_price: the consumer price of meat is higher
tax_meat_reduces_meat_consumption: a tax on meat would significantly reduce meat consumption
tobacco_tax_case: the case of a tax on tobacco
synthetic_meat_development_advanced: the development of synthetic meats is advanced
more_dangerous_meat_production: meat producers switch to cheaper and more dangerous means of producing meat
farming_industry_not_meat_is_problem: the animal farming industry, not meat itself, is what is problematic
animal_farming_industry_regulated: the animal farming industry is regulated
meat_problems_resolved: the problems associated with meat production and consumption are resolved
noncultured_meat_inherently_problematic: non-cultured meat production is inherently problematic at the current human population size, whatever the production method
meat_price_below_real_costs: the consumer price of meat is below the real costs of meat consumption
meat_price_reflects_real_costs: the consumer price of meat reflects the real costs of meat consumption
subsidy_distortions_removed: the price distortions caused by subsidies are removed
nature_2020_external_cost_study: the authors of a 2020 scientific analysis of the external costs of foods (Nature Communications)
external_costs_of_food: the external costs of food (life-cycle assessment)
external_ghg_costs_highest_for_animal_pr: external greenhouse gas costs are typically highest for animal-based products
policy_to_close_food_price_gap_urgent: policy measures that close the gap between current market prices and the true costs of food are urgent
food_less_affordable_for_poor: food becomes more expensive for the many people who cannot afford it
avoid_meat_tax_burden: avoiding the added cost that the meat tax puts on food
other_protein_cheaper_than_meat: other sources of protein are currently cheaper than meat
food_production_costs_increased: the costs of food production increase
starvation_from_reduced_meat_access: people starve because the tax reduces their access to meat
harms_of_high_meat_consumption: the harms of high meat consumption (those the pros of the tax cite)
at_risk_people_eat_little_meat: people who would starve from higher food costs rarely or never eat meat, which is mostly unaffordable to them
at_risk_diets_are_staples: the diets of those people consist mainly or only of maize, flour or rice
meat_tax_leaves_staple_prices: a meat tax does not raise the prices of the staples those people eat
plant_foods_iron_rich_and_healthy: various beans and lentils contain lots of iron and are healthy
protein_intake_of_millions_reduced: the protein intake of millions of people is reduced
government_push_for_insect_protein: governments push to incentivize eating insects as a protein alternative
unhealthy_meat_underconsumption: meat is underconsumed to an unhealthy degree
unhealthy_underconsumption_prevented: unhealthy underconsumption of meat is prevented
north_american_meat_consumption: meat consumption by North American citizens
meat_consumption_above_guidelines: meat consumption above what dietary guidelines recommend
dietary_guideline_authorities: the authorities that issue dietary guidelines
eating_more_meat_than_recommended_is_unh: eating more meat than dietary guidelines recommend is unhealthy
meat_reduction_studies: meta-analyses and reviews of studies and trials on meat reduction
meat_reduction_improves_health: meat reduction and vegetarianism result in better health, lower mortality and longer lifespans, not in worse health
meat_eating_is_personal_choice: eating meat is a personal choice
individual_liberty_over_meat_eating: individuals are at liberty to decide whether and how much meat to eat
state_stays_out_of_meat_eating: the state stays out of individuals' meat eating
imported_meat_relatively_cheaper: imported meat becomes cheaper relative to domestic meat through dumping and predatory pricing
domestic_meat_industry_pushed_out: domestic meat producers are pushed out of the market
domestic_producers_protected_from_import: domestic meat producers are not pushed out of the market by cheaper imported meat
cheap_open_meat_trade: meat imports stay cheap and trade stays open
meat_tax_proponents: the proponents of a meat tax
meat_tax_case: the case of a tax on meat
tobacco_tax_reduced_tobacco_consumption: a tax on tobacco significantly reduced tobacco consumption
